integrity: The all-set characterization follows directly from the unique geodesics created by pendant vertices over a clique. Strict log-concavity is proved by checking the three inequalities affected by the extra quadratic coefficient and using strict log-concavity of the scaled binomial tail. A separate definition-level checker reconstructs graph distances and tests every subset.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers only complete-graph bases in the corona with K_1.
It does not resolve corona preservation of unimodality for general base graphs.
The exhaustive verification through n=10 is corroborative only.
Search coverage cannot exclude an unindexed equivalent formula.
title: Strict log-concavity for complete-graph coronas
